name: Murali Pillai
profileSummary: Kunjan Muralidharan Pillai is a Singaporean politician and lawyer who has been serving as Senior Minister of State for Transport and Senior Minister of State for Law since 2025. A member of the governing People's Action Party (PAP), he has been the Member of Parliament (MP) for the Bukit Batok division of Jurong East–Bukit Batok Group Representation Constituency (GRC) since 2025. He had previously represented Bukit Batok Single Member Constituency (SMC) between 2016 and 2025. He currently co-helms, with Dinesh Vasu Dash, the Indian Engagement and Development Initiative committee tasked with deepening engagement amongst the Singapore Indian community and focusing on areas such as social upliftment, integration and leadership development.
